fixed_issue: Viewpoint east/west rotations previously disagreed with the 2D sprites after current ObjReader horizontal-axis conversion.
evidence: Current local PZVoxelStudio mini-fridge binds S=0, E=-90, N=180, W=90.
tests/integration_viewpoint.java actually calls installed Viewpoint ObjReader, PackBind.place, and PackManifest.parse.
tests/integration_viewpoint_result.txt contains the passing four-facing assertions and empty manifest errors.
tools/assets_build.py regenerated runtime model, material, PNG, tiles, texture pack and manifest.
Current PZ TexturePackPage and Viewpoint ObjReader were rerun against final pack and OBJ and passed.

integration_review.tile_custom_item: CustomItem names the exact SuQingFreshnessFridge.Mov_FreshnessFridge script item; native ISMoveableSpriteProps uses this value for creation.
integration_review.power: Native IsoObject.addToWorld first creates sprite containers, then registers objects with fridge/freezer containers with the chunk generator list. IsoThumpable.addToWorld calls this superclass method. A single fridge container is recognized by native getGeneratorPowerConsumption as the ordinary single-compartment fridge rate.
integration_review.registration: Installed Viewpoint ModelPacksLua.register returns a primitive Java boolean. The Lua wrapper marks registered only for ok and truthy result and retries on immediate load, OnGameBoot, OnGameStart.
integration_review.load_order: Building and Runtime explicitly require shared Core; client Building requires shared Building. Optional Viewpoint file does not require Core and correctly tolerates absent Viewpoint.

limitations: Offline parser and source/control-flow verification only. No game bootstrap or UI operation. In-game placement, visuals, collision and electrical behavior remain user acceptance.
